attempted_claim: Let K be the hyperbolic fibered knot 10_145 in S3 and let Y2 be closed 4-surgery on K. Verify that Y2 is a closed orientable hyperbolic rational homology sphere with H_1=Z/4, and note that Zung 2411.00227 establishes a transverse foliation for the natural pseudo-Anosov flow for slopes s<3 and obstructs it for s in [5,infinity), leaving s=4 open. Decide with proof whether Y2 admits a co-orientable taut foliation transverse to that flow (carried by the veering branched surface): either construct such a transverse foliation via branched-surface inequalities, or prove a Milnor-Wood-type obstruction to any transverse foliation; either proven side for this single named Y2 counts as complete.
claim_type: transverse-to-flow foliation existence-or-obstruction for named surgery (veering gap slope)
decisive_failure: The boundary-track switch model (triangle-interior switches with large side opposite the taut pi-corner) is structurally contradicted by Zung Lemma 5.1, and the turn-sign slope pipeline is invalid; the slope -1/2 decision for 4-surgery on 10_145 remains open. Frozen artifacts (triangulation file, corner tables, enumeration scripts) are preserved for a future vertex-switch rebuild but support no auditable claim in their current form.
